line.name: E.P. Carrillo Encore El Futuro
line.background_text: The first regular-production line extension of Encore since its 2018 launch, unveiled April 2022. Unlike the original Encore's Ecuadorian wrapper, El Futuro uses an all-Nicaraguan wrapper/binder/filler blend, tobaccos aged in tercios before rolling. Production at Tabacalera La Alianza S.A., initial limited run of 1,000 boxes ahead of the 2022 PCA trade show.

research_notes: Genuinely distinct from plain Encore (all-Nicaraguan wrapper vs. Ecuadorian). Strength labeled 'Medium' based on general Encore-line positioning, not a numeric source - lower confidence. Price per stick not found.
